blocked.name: Cut Short
blocked.why: 'target planeswalker that was activated this turn' — the engine tracks only loyaltyActivatedThisTurn, the ruling counts any activated ability of the planeswalker

blocked.name: Flockchaser Phantom
blocked.why: 'the next spell you cast this turn has convoke' — no way to grant convoke to a spell before it's cast

blocked.name: Glissa, Herald of Predation
blocked.why: mode 2 'Transform all Incubator tokens you control' — transform takes one target, no mass form

blocked.name: Ichor Elixir
blocked.why: planar dice replacement; Planechase not modeled

blocked.name: Ichor Shade
blocked.why: intervening-if 'an artifact or creature was put into a graveyard from the battlefield this turn' — turn history has died (creatures) and left (any zone), nothing for a noncreature artifact to a graveyard

blocked.name: Rampaging Raptor
blocked.why: Its damage trigger targets 'planeswalker that player controls or battle that player protects': no single target slot takes either.

blocked.name: Streetwise Negotiator
blocked.why: backup grants 'assigns combat damage equal to its toughness', a static ability

blocked.name: Vulpine Harvester
blocked.why: 'their total power' — the total power of the attacking Phyrexians of the batch, LKI at resolution (ruling); no attack-batch amount

blocked.name: Wildwood Escort
blocked.why: "If this creature would die, exile it instead": the object's own exile replacement (`self: true`) ignores `from: "battlefield"` (Game.exilesItselfInstead), so it would also exile the card when countered on the stack; the external dies-only form has no filter for "this object".

blocked.name: War Historian
blocked.why: 'As long as it attacked a battle this turn': no condition records what a creature attacked this turn.

blocked.name: Angelic Intervention
blocked.why: Grants protection from colorless or from a color chosen on resolution until end of turn; protection is only a static field, no temporary chosen-colour grant.

blocked.name: Progenitor Exarch
blocked.why: 'Incubate 3 X times' needs X separate Incubator tokens of 3 counters each; incubate has no times/repeat and there is no generic repeat-N effect.

blocked.name: Path of the Schemer
blocked.why: 'It's an artifact in addition to its other types' on the creature put onto the battlefield: look-and-choose's enterAs (EnterTypes) has setTypes/addSubtypes/addColors but no added card type; a later add-types would miss 'whenever an artifact enters'.

blocked.name: Final Flourish
blocked.why: Kicker is 'Sacrifice an artifact or creature'; kicker.cost is mana only (bargain's fixed sacrifice is artifact/enchantment/token).

blocked.name: Borborygmos and Fblthp
blocked.why: 'You may discard any number of land cards' then a reflexive trigger for twice that much damage; no filtered discard-any-number.

blocked.name: Expedition Lookout
blocked.why: 'As long as an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard' — cards-in-graveyard only counts your own graveyard.

blocked.name: Disturbing Conversion
blocked.why: -X/-0 where X is the cards in the enchanted creature's controller's graveyard; grantPtPerCount.inGraveyard counts from the Aura controller's side only.

blocked.name: Liliana's Talent
blocked.why: An Aura granting the enchanted planeswalker a [-8] loyalty ability: statics can't grant loyalty abilities (the damage-to-enchanted-planeswalker trigger has no 'attached' recipient either).

blocked.name: Bright-Palm, Soul Awakener
blocked.why: 'That creature can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less this turn' on a target: cantBeBlockedBy exists only as a static, no one-shot grant until end of turn.

blocked.name: Quintorius, Loremaster
blocked.why: 'Choose target card exiled with Quintorius' has no exile-zone/linked target spec, and the free cast-this-turn permission has no 'put it on the bottom of its owner's library instead' replacement.

blocked.name: Axgard Artisan
blocked.why: counters-put has no firstTimeEachTurn; oncePerTurn differs (it would fire on a later placement if the first one didn't trigger).

blocked.name: Wicked Slumber
blocked.why: 'Put a stun counter on either of them. Then put a stun counter on either of them.' is a resolution-time choice among the targets, twice (both may go on one); counters-divided is chosen at cast with at least one each.

blocked.name: Elspeth's Smite
blocked.why: 'If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead' on the target: no turn-long exile-instead replacement on a target.

blocked.name: Seer of Stolen Sight
blocked.why: 'One or more artifacts and/or creatures you control are put into a graveyard from the battlefield' needs a batched leaves-battlefield trigger that counts tokens and sees Seer dying with them; put-into-graveyard skips tokens and doesn't look back.

blocked.name: Mirror-Shield Hoplite
blocked.why: becomes-target can't narrow to a backup ability as the targeting source (copy-ability itself is built).

blocked.name: Chomping Kavu
blocked.why: Backup grants the static 'can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less'; the backup helper grants only keywords, triggered and activated abilities.

blocked.name: Swordsworn Cavalier
blocked.why: Its ruling: if it enters, leaves and returns the same turn, its earlier self is 'another Knight' and it has first strike. turn-history's excludeSelf skips by object id (characteristics.ts turnHistoryCount), so the earlier stint is excluded too.

blocked.name: Bloodfeather Phoenix
blocked.why: 'Whenever an instant or sorcery spell you control deals damage to an opponent or battle', triggering from the graveyard: no such trigger.

blocked.name: Onakke Javelineer
blocked.why: '{T}: deals 2 damage to target player or battle': no single target slot takes a player or a battle.

blocked.name: Excise the Imperfect
blocked.why: "Its controller incubates X": the incubate effect has no who/controllerOfTarget, so it always makes the Incubator for the caster

blocked.name: Elspeth's Talent
blocked.why: activates-ability with who:"attached" ignores loyalty:true and doesn't check that you (the Aura's controller) activated it — would fire for any ability, and for an opponent who controls the enchanted planeswalker

blocked.name: Gimbal, Gremlin Prodigy
blocked.why: create-token's thenCounters amount is evaluated before the Gremlin token exists, so X (differently named artifact tokens you control) misses the new Gremlin Token itself

blocked.name: Vivien's Talent
blocked.why: "put a loyalty counter on enchanted planeswalker": no EffectTargetRef or filter names the permanent this Aura is attached to

blocked.name: Stasis Field
blocked.why: "loses all other abilities" as a static on the enchanted creature; lose-abilities exists only as an effect, not a StaticAbility field

blocked.name: Corruption of Towashi
blocked.why: "or a permanent you control enters transformed": no trigger or filter for a permanent entering with its back face up (the transforms trigger is built, this half isn't)

blocked.name: Tenured Oilcaster
blocked.why: "+3/+0 as long as an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard": cards-in-graveyard/threshold read only your own graveyard

blocked.name: Nahiri's Warcrafting
blocked.why: Look at the top X (X = excess damage), you may exile one with "you may play it this turn" (lands too), rest bottom in random order: look-and-choose's `exile` destination grants no play permission, `allow-cast-from-exile` is cast-only, and `exile-playable` is only a leftover.

blocked.name: Infernal Sovereign
blocked.why: 'Skip your draw step.' — no static that skips a player's draw step

blocked.name: Sandsteppe War Riders
blocked.why: bolster X (put counters on a creature with the least toughness, chosen on resolution) — no bolster effect in the engine

blocked.name: Oculus Whelp
blocked.why: 'As long as you control a transformed permanent' — no filter/condition for a transformed (back-face-up TDFC) permanent

blocked.name: Rowan's Talent
blocked.why: 'Whenever you activate a loyalty ability of enchanted planeswalker': activates-ability who:'attached' ignores both `loyalty` and who activated it, so an opponent's activation on an enchanted opponent's walker (or any non-loyalty ability) would wrongly copy

blocked.name: Hidetsugu and Kairi
blocked.why: dies trigger: 'Target opponent loses life equal to its mana value' — no EffectAmount for the card exiled this way, and a look-and-choose/reveal-until `then` replaces the outer targets, losing the target opponent

blocked.name: Path of the Ghosthunter
blocked.why: Will of the Planeswalkers: votes to planeswalk or for chaos to ensue, and there are no planar decks

blocked.name: Rankle and Torbran
blocked.why: Mode 3 "If a source would deal damage to a player or battle this turn, it deals that much damage plus 2 instead": no effect creates a turn-long +N damage replacement for any source (player-effect damageTo is a multiplier to named players only), and no would-deal-damage recipient scope is "player or battle". Modes 1 and 2 and the any-number modal trigger are fine.

blocked.name: Cutthroat Negotiator
blocked.why: each player reveals their top card and you count the nonland ones; reveal-top only reveals the controller's library or a target owner's

blocked.name: Complete the Circuit
blocked.why: 'You may cast sorcery spells this turn as though they had flash' is only a static (castAsThoughFlash), with no until-end-of-turn effect form

blocked.name: Realmbreaker's Grasp
blocked.why: 'its activated abilities can't be activated unless they're mana abilities' on the enchanted permanent: prohibits.abilitiesOf can't pick the attached permanent and includes mana abilities

blocked.name: Teferi's Talent
blocked.why: the granted -12 makes an emblem whose static (loyalty abilities at instant speed on any turn) isn't a creatures-you-control anthem; emblem statics beyond anthems aren't read (AUTHORING §15)

blocked.name: Death-Greeter's Champion
blocked.why: Dash {3}{R} isn't built (no dash field/alt cost anywhere in the engine); backup + double strike alone would drop it

blocked.name: Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen
blocked.why: The front face's ability targets 'opponent or battle': no single target slot takes either.

blocked.name: Zurgo and Ojutai
blocked.why: "Whenever one or more Dragons you control deal combat damage to a player or battle" is a batched trigger once per player/battle damaged (the ruling), and "you may return one of those Dragons" needs the batch's creatures; deals-damage-batch is player-only with no reference to the batch.

blocked.name: Render Inert
blocked.why: 'remove up to five counters' of kinds the caster chooses (the ruling); remove-counter needs one named kind

blocked.name: Overgrown Pest
blocked.why: 'reveal a land or double-faced card' — CardFilter has no double-faced clause

blocked.name: Mutagen Connoisseur
blocked.why: '+1/+0 for each transformed permanent you control' — CardFilter has no transformed (back-face-up) clause

blocked.name: Invasion of Tarkir // Defiant Thundermaw
blocked.why: front: 'reveal any number of Dragon cards from your hand', then a reflexive trigger dealing X+2 where X is the number revealed — no reveal-any-number-from-hand effect with a count

blocked.name: Invasion of Kaldheim // Pyre of the World Tree
blocked.why: front: exile your hand, draw that many, play the exiled cards until the end of your next turn — impulse-exile only exiles from a library (the back face is authorable)

blocked.name: Invasion of Amonkhet // Lazotep Convert
blocked.why: back: 'enter as a copy of any creature card in a graveyard' — copyOnEnter only copies battlefield permanents

blocked.name: Invasion of Gobakhan // Lightshield Array
blocked.why: front: exile a nonland card from target opponent's hand; its owner may play it while it stays exiled, costing {2} more

blocked.name: Invasion of New Capenna // Holy Frazzle-Cannon
blocked.why: back: 'put a +1/+1 counter on that creature and each other creature you control that shares a creature type with it' — add-counter-all can't leave out the trigger object (only the source or a target slot), so the equipped creature would get two counters

blocked.name: Invasion of New Phyrexia // Teferi Akosa of Zhalfir
blocked.why: back: -2 emblem 'Knights you control get +1/+0 and have ward {1}' (emblem statics are a creatures-you-control anthem only); -3 'tap any number of untapped creatures' with X = the number tapped

blocked.name: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders
blocked.why: front: search your library, graveyard and/or outside the game

blocked.name: Invasion of Alara // Awaken the Maelstrom
blocked.why: front: exile until two nonland MV<=4 cards, you may cast one free, one goes to hand (if none is cast, the other stays exiled — the ruling), the rest to the bottom at random; back: 'is all colors', untargeted token copy and distributed counters chosen on resolution

blocked.name: Invasion of Regatha // Disciples of the Inferno
blocked.why: front: '4 damage to another target battle or opponent' — no single target slot for a battle or an opponent (the back face's +2 replacement is expressible as two would-deal-damage statics: to 'opponent' and toFilter creature/battle)

blocked.name: Invasion of Ravnica // Guildpact Paragon
blocked.why: front 'isn't exactly two colors', back 'a spell that's exactly two colors' / 'a card that's exactly two colors' — CardFilter has multicolored (2+) but no colour count

blocked.name: Invasion of Eldraine // Prickle Faeries
blocked.why: back: intervening-if 'if that player has two or fewer cards in hand' at each opponent's upkeep — the hand-size condition reads only you or each player

blocked.name: Invasion of Azgol // Ashen Reaper
blocked.why: back: 'if a permanent was put into a graveyard from the battlefield this turn' — turn history has 'left' (any destination) and 'died' (creatures), not to-graveyard-from-battlefield

blocked.name: Invasion of Pyrulea // Gargantuan Slabhorn
blocked.why: front: 'if it's a land or double-faced card, draw'; back: 'other transformed permanents you control have trample and ward {2}' — no double-faced or transformed CardFilter clause
